lines.en: But for now, I must return home to the girl I started the day with. And anyone else who may have found their way inside during my absence.
So, the Tsukiokas apparently.
: Hey, guys. Check out this cool knife I just got.
: That is very nice, Sensei. Thank you for showing us.
Now, you may be asking “what are these two doing here so late? And on Chrismas Eve nonetheless?”
Me too.
But I imagine it has something to do with the Christmas party based on the way Tsubasa is happily clasping her hands together and staring at me like the piece of meat I am.
Oh, right. I probably should have mentioned the party is going to be at their place this year.
Surprise.
: Excellent! Just the man I was hoping to encounter.
: Sorry, Tsubasa. I’m all tapped out for today. So if you’re looking for a Chrismas date too, you’re going to need to wait until tomorrow.
: I beg your pardon?
: Nothing. Please don’t kill me.
: Hah. Sensei, we’re here to discuss the logistics of this year’s Christmas party.
: I figured. You should have heard my thoughts just a second ago.
: Right! So, the situation is like this.
: Tsukasa will be spending the evening with you as well. Thank you for your assistance in watching over her.
: What? That’s a terrible idea. The girls are always really insistent on kissing each other during that party and she might get caught up in the crossfire.
: We can always just...omit her from spin the bottle. Or not play it altogether.
: But then I won’t get to see you all kiss each other and that’s become my favorite part of Christmas.
: You weren’t even there last year. You were in a coma.
: That doesn’t mean I wasn’t dreaming about it.
: My, what an interesting life you lead! You can tell my youngest daughter all about it while you’re tending to her at the party.
: Apologies, Sensei. I’ve already tried reasoning with Mother. But, as it turns out, my father will be hosting several of his associates in the grand ballroom during the time of our party and-
: And only “Jeeves” can prevent Tsukasa from intervening and potentially ruining any dealings Tomonori and I will be involved in. Thank you again for your assistance.
: Why are you working on Christmas? Take a day off.
: I would love to! But I’ve already used my free time this quarter drinking wine as I watched you donate milk to those less fortunate.
: What a strange way to word that.
: I had no idea you’d gotten involved with charity work, Sensei. Perhaps I can help you donate milk as well in the future?
: Yes! Wouldn’t that be nice?
: Just please do me this one little favor and I’ll see to it that your wildest dreams come true.
: Vacation days are for those in lower tax brackets, unfortunately.
: Just please do me this one little favor and I’ll see to it that your wildest dreams come true.
: You are gravely underestimating just how wild my dreams are.
: And you are gravely underestimating just how important this meeting is. Just agree, darling. You really don’t have a say in the matter.
: Forgive Mother’s pushiness tonight, Sensei. This is a rather last-minute arrangement and I believe that one of our staff members may have spiked her eggnog.
: Oh, okay. So we can use the fact that she’s drunk to justify her asking me to babysit your sister. That works.
: Drunk? Heavens, no. If I was drunk, I imagine you’d be strapped down to something right now.
: What?
: She’s drunk. Don’t listen to her.
: Then perhaps you should take up negotiations in my stead, Touka? Perhaps there’s something you can add that would sweeten the pot for your beloved teacher?
: B-Beloved?! No! B-Besides! There’s no need for negotiation when Sensei was already planning on agreeing! Weren’t you, S- oh. He’s stopped paying attention to us.
: Perhaps it is because his maid is glaring daggers at him for some reason beyond my comprehension?
: That’s no maid, Mother. That’s a famous pop star.
: Ha! And I’m the princess of Andorra.
: But...you are.
: Honorarily, Touka. That’s completely different. Now, be a dear and fetch me a red from Akira’s wine cellar.
: Fine. But I must first find said wine cellar and I’m unsure of where the poor would even fit such a thing.
: Over here, Touka. I’ll show you.
: Oh, wonderful. Thank you, Ayane. I still feel rather uncomfortable when it comes to places like this.
: Am I in trouble again? Because you’ve been staring at me for a really long time.
: I’m just wondering if unidentified women showing up is going to be a normal thing now that I live here.
: I don’t think you want to hear the answer to that question. But if you want a solution, all you really need to do is identify them and your problem will be no-more.
: Please don’t make me sleep on the couch in my own house.
: Hah...I suppose all I can do is get used to it. Did your date go well, at least?
: I’d show you the knife I got out of it, but I don’t want you to take it away as punishment for me simply existing.
: I’m somewhat confused by the dynamic at play here. Why is there an apparently famous pop star living with you, Akira? And why do the two of you seem so close?
: I don’t know. She just showed up one day and refuses to leave.
: We’re childhood friends.
: Oh, are you? How interesting. But why do you appear so pained to admit that?
: Because I am.
: I’m confused. I see no wine cellar here.
: Is there a secret passage I’m unaware of? Is it behind the curtain? Beneath the tree?
: There is no wine cellar. I just wanted to prevent you from wandering around looking confused for the next half hour.
: Where does he keep the wine then?
: People from middle class families don’t always have wine on-hand. That’s kind of a rich person thing.
: Is that so? I had no idea. Thank you for your assistance, Ayane. You’re as invaluable as ever when it comes to teaching me the ways of these people. I can’t help but admire how well you’ve adapted.
: No worries! It’s kind of easy for me, though. I was actually pretty poor before the whole bubble wrap thing happened.
: Oh, joy! That statement makes it sound as if I’m about to be blessed by an anecdote about adversity and the role Christmas plays in reminding you to always remain humble!
: No. I don’t have anything like that tonight. I just needed somebody to talk to since Ami and Maya are being weird and Sensei is busy with the other adults.
: Oh. Well, I suppose I am someone. But I feel as if neglecting my mother in her current state may lead to her saying or doing something self-destructive.
: Really? She seems fine to me. I wouldn’t have even known she was drunk if you hadn’t said something.
: Yes, she hides it well in short bursts. But she can be rather...crass when it comes to certain subjects.
: Like...what kind of subjects?
: Physical therapy?
: I don’t think they’re going to bring that up, Touka.
: I never do either until it’s too late.

: Well, rest assured that the Arakawa house is a safe zone for everyone! And that anything discussed here shall remain within these walls so long as the concerned party has signed the required waivers.
: W...Waivers?
: Ah! You didn’t sign the waivers?!
: I-I didn’t know there were waivers! I’ve been here in the past and I’ve never had to sign such a thing before!
: Oh my God! You’re in grave danger then, Touka! We’ve gotta get your signature quick or your family’s entire legacy could be in jeopardy!
: You know, I’m very glad you’ve brought up the topic of physical therapy, Niki. Because I have many opinions to share concerning-
: Mother, no!
: Something I’ve learned tonight is that it’s extremely hard watching movies with a crowd of unruly people who refuse to shut up behind you.
: And that’s why I only watch movies at the Alamo Drafthouse.
: The what?
: Sponsorship message. Don’t worry about it. Besides, the movie’s going to be over soon anyway. And aren’t you going back to the dorms with Ayane to play D&D?
: It’s almost midnight already. I just want to sleep at this point. I’m getting too old to be staying up playing games. Especially when I’m expected to go to a party the next day.
: You could always come with me and Niki to her concert thingy. I’m sure she wouldn’t mind if I brought a friend.
: Yeah, but then I’d have to actually be around Niki.
: She’s not that bad, Maya! Like sure, she has way too much sex with Sensei. But day by day, I can feel her getting closer to letting me join in!
: Ew.
: Maybe you coming with us to the concert can help get you in on the ground level so we can all do it together one day?
: Can’t we just do it without her involved?
: We’ll do that too. Especially now that I don’t have to pretend I haven’t made you cum your brains out a million times before.
: Didn’t you agree to stop bringing that up after the whole...reset thing happened or...whatever you call it?
: I agree to a lot of things. But I’ve learned that I’m the happiest when I just do whatever I want regardless of that. And right now, I’m just surprised you’re still here!
: But that also makes me really curious about what I can do to you before you snap. And why you’re still so friendly with me despite the many forced orgasms I’ve made you endure.

: It’s specifically because of those things that I feel like I need to stay on good terms with you. I can deal with being chained up every now and then if it brings me closer to figuring out what the fuck is going on here.
: You sure it’s not just because you want me to finger you again?
: Kind of, yeah.
: Well, why don’t you just talk to Sensei and Ayane about it then? I’m sure they have some answers to whatever questions you might have.
: Probably because you told me the moment you realized I was still here that you would blow up the world if I informed them of your existence.
: And you believed me?
: I’d be foolish not to at this point.
: Awesome! Having a cat rules!
: If I, like...talked to them about me, though-
: Oh. Yeah. That’s fine. Just keep me out of it. All things considered, I’m kind of enjoying this timeline. It’s...what’s the word...nostalgic?
: Really? You won’t, like...tie me up again if I go “poking my nose in places it doesn’t belong” or whatever?
: Not unless you want me to!
: Or if I get bored. Or angry. Or any other emotion that’s too intense for me to properly process and I need an outlet to vent my frustration.
: What? It’s super creepy when you just look at me like that. Stop.
: You’re just...
: So different from the Ami I remember. It’s kind of surreal.
: Like...it still feels like I’m stuck in that dream.
: That wasn’t a dream, Maya.
: It was something much...much scarier...
I manage to escape from Niki and Tsubasa long enough to catch my breath.
And with the clock creeping ever closer to Christmas, I think it might finally be time for me to close my eyes and wait for what tomorrow brings.
It’s great that nothing horrible happened today. I don’t get days like that very often anymore.
And any opportunity I get to steer clear of past traumas is fine by me.
I’ve gotta take what I can get in Kumon-mi. And right now, that means taking a break.
That’s right. Today is going to be one of those rare nights when-
: Ahem.
I should have just gone to my room.
: Hello.
: Merry...Christmas?
: You sound unsure.
: I am...unsure about many things all of a sudden.
: Is one of them the amount of time I am willing to speak to you before walking away?
: As a matter of fact, it is.
: Well, time is running out. So if you’ve got anything important to say-
: Retract your breakup with me. Teach me about my other self. Stop ignoring my calls. My birthday is next week. And also, I’m horny.
: Like, really horny. And we both know how you feel about these pajamas. So I think it would be in both of our best interests if you were to rail the fuck out of me right now.
: Like, really just go to town. Pull my hair. Spank me. Choke me. The whole nine yards, buddy.
: Did you just call me “Buddy?”
: I am beyond the point of acting rationally right now. This is but one more reason you should whisk me off my feet and carry me away to Bonetown.
: Oh, come on! How did that not work?!
: Goodnight, Maya.
: And merry Christmas.
: “Merry Christmas” my ass.
: You just walk away every time I try to talk to you now...
: I thought we were finally going somewhere?...
: But then that stupid childhood friend of yours had to show up again and...
: I have to persist! That’s what the “old” me did, so that’s what the “new” one will do as well!
: He will be mine...
: Oh, yes.
: He will be mine.
: Hey. Uhh...Maya, right? You okay? Because it seems like you’re talking to yourself and-
: Leave me alone! And stop being so perfect! I swear, it’s like you Nakayamas are the luxury cars of Japanese women and I won’t stand for it much longer!
: Goodnight! I hope you have a terrible Christmas!
: So is just...everyone insane here? Or...
Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!
Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!
Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
Niki’s affection has increased to [niki_love]!
Around one hour later...
Maybe closer to ninety minutes...
Either way, it’s really late right now...
That’s all you need to know...
